graham.brief:
This one comes down to what each offense wants to be and who's built to stop it. Arizona's pass defense gives up more through the air than almost anyone, 6th-worst in the league. One of those has to give.

Arizona is the 2nd-most pass-first offense in football, throwing more than the situation calls for. I keep turning this one over and it keeps coming out undecided.

Arizona rarely sends extra rushers, which is the one thing San Francisco handles well. Brock Purdy is the starter who's played 92% of the snaps, and San Francisco carries the 6th-heaviest injury load in the league.

The books are half a step away from that. San Francisco is favored by 8.5 with a 47.5 total. Nothing decisive on my side, and the price is only slightly braver. The books have trimmed Purdy's number all week, and that usually reads as fewer throws, not more. Watch for Arizona to look like the team its early-down numbers describe. Or not.
